_source: Crew brief Nov 7 2026 (final) - price law. Draft copy for Grokbot to wire. Do not change numbers here; they mirror config.
_rules: No countdowns, timers, 'only X left', 'last chance', or 'don't miss'. State terms once, plainly. Schools/staff copy never shows parent prices.

en.plans_intro: Start with the free set. It stays free. When you want the full library, here is what it costs.
en.trial_line: Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial of the full library.

founding.label: Founding Family
founding.renewal: Then $49 a year, locked for as long as you stay.
founding.terms: Available to families who join before January 1, 2027.
founding.why: Founding Families are the first homes to use Hani. This price is our thank-you for helping shape it.

en.schools_line: Teachers and schools use Hani free, always. Talk with us about bringing it to your school.
en.checkout_note: Payments are handled securely by Stripe on hudsonseed.com.
en.board_line: Try the free board at hudsonseed.com. No cost, no login.
en.trial_cta: Get in line for the free Hani trial
en.email_fine: We use your email only for Hani. No child information is ever collected.

es.plans_intro: Empiece con el conjunto gratuito. Sigue siendo gratis. Cuando quiera la biblioteca completa, este es el costo.

founding.label: Familia Fundadora
founding.renewal: Después $49 al año, fijo mientras siga con nosotros.
founding.terms: Disponible para familias que se unan antes del 1 de enero de 2027.
founding.why: Las Familias Fundadoras son los primeros hogares que usan Hani. Este precio es nuestro agradecimiento por ayudarnos a darle forma.

es.schools_line: Maestros y escuelas usan Hani gratis, siempre. Hable con nosotros para llevarlo a su escuela.
